Incorporated in the Republic of South Africa
NOTICE OF AVAILABILITY OF SELECTED HALF-YEAR 2025 COMPARATIVE INFORMATION

Shareholders and noteholders are advised that, in accordance with IFRS 8, comparative segment information for the six months ended 30 June 2025 and the year ended 31 December 2025 has been restated to reflect the final allocation of entities and activities between operating segments.

The restatement affects only the allocation of amounts between reportable segments and has no impact on the Group's previously reported earnings per share, headline earnings per share, statement of financial position, statement of changes in equity, statement of cash flows, and/or statement of profits or loss and other comprehensive income. The restatement comparative is published and available here: https://www.oldmutual.com/omdocs/bltdfdf52a1b9aaf956/Restatement_of_Comparative_Information_H1_2026.pdf

Old Mutual is in the process of finalising its financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026. These results will be released on the Stock Exchange News Service of the JSE Limited on Tuesday, 8 September 2026.
This announcement is available on the Old Mutual website https://www.oldmutual.com/investor-relations/reporting-centre
Johannesburg Stock Exchange: Tamela Holdings (Proprietary) Limited
JSE debt sponsor:             Nedbank Corporate and Investment Banking, a division of Nedbank   Limited
Namibia Stock Exchange:      PSG Wealth Management (Namibia) (Proprietary) Limited
Victoria Falls Stock Exchange:     Imara Capital Zimbabwe plc
Malawi Stock Exchange:       Stockbrokers Malawi Limited

Old Mutual is a premium African financial services group that offers a broad spectrum of financial solutions to retail and corporate customers across key market segments in 12 countries. Old Mutual's primary operations are in Africa and it has a niche business in China. With over 181 years of heritage across sub-Saharan Africa, Old Mutual is a crucial part of the communities it serves as well as broader society on the continent.
For further information on Old Mutual and its underlying businesses, please visit the Corporate website at www.oldmutual.com
